# People360

> People360 is an AI-powered talent development platform offering mentoring, coaching, alumni management, and predictive analytics to transform workplace culture and employee engagement.

People360 (formerly Insala) provides enterprise HR solutions for Fortune 500 and Global 1000 companies, combining software platforms (Thrive, Hive, Dive systems) with professional services and training to support career development, talent management, and workforce planning initiatives.

## Key Topics

- People360 Platform
- Insala
- Mentoring Software
- Coaching Software
- Alumni Management
- Predictive Analytics
- Career Transition
- Talent Development
- Employee Engagement
- HRIS Integration
- Thrive System
- Hive System
- Dive System
- Program Management
- Workforce Planning

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [People 360](https://www.people360ai.com/people360): People360 platform overview: Thrive, Hive, Dive systems for workplace transformation
- [Predictive People Analytics](https://www.people360ai.com/en-us/predictive-people-analytics): Predictive analytics with AI and NLP for HR decisions and workforce planning insights
- [Mentoring Software](https://www.people360ai.com/en-us/mentoring): Mentoring software with mentor matching and enrollment platform for talent development
- [Coaching Software](https://www.people360ai.com/en-us/coaching): Insala coaching software for program management, measurement, and coach matching
- [Alumni Management Software](https://www.people360ai.com/en-us/alumni): Alumni management software for corporate networks, brand ambassadors, and engagement
- [Career Transition Software](https://www.people360ai.com/en-us/career-transition): Outplacement and career transition software automating candidate management process

## Implementation & Services

- [Professional Services](https://www.people360ai.com/en-us/services): Insala professional services for career development strategy and program design
- [Corporate Mentoring Programs](https://www.people360ai.com/en-us/corporate-mentoring): Corporate mentoring program implementation and best practices from Insala experts
- [Employee Coaching Programs](https://www.people360ai.com/en-us/employee-coaching): Employee coaching program implementation guide with customized organizational development
- [Training Programs](https://www.people360ai.com/en-us/training): Customized software training for People360 solutions and career development programs
